Act as the implementation sub-agent for this task.

Fix GitHub issue #233 in Moneo:
- Add the supported `server-only` boundary to lib/supabase-server.ts, lib/service-db.ts, lib/service-keys.ts, lib/bank/server.ts and lib/scalable/server.ts. Check the Next.js docs in node_modules/next/dist/docs/ first, and make sure Vitest still works (e.g. alias `server-only` in the vitest config if needed).
- Remove the serviceDb re-export from lib/bank/server.ts, and point every caller and mock at lib/service-db.ts.
- Source build and desktop build (`npm run desktop:build` if the backend is fetched, otherwise at least `npm run build`) must pass.
- If you add an enforcement, add a row for it to the AGENTS.md rules table.

## RESUME: earlier work may exist
A stopped agent may have left uncommitted work in `C:/Users/mgsuk/.t3/worktrees/Moneo/t3-932b500a-3deb8e8deca2b7b7` (branch `t3/issue-233-server-only`).
- Inspect it read-only (`git -C <path> status` / `diff`).
- Bring over what's useful: apply its diff into your own checkout and copy its untracked files. Never modify, reset or delete that worktree.
- Use your own branch `t3/issue-233-server-boundary` from current `origin/main`.
- Commit as soon as the earlier work is applied, and after each step.

## Rules
- Read AGENTS.md first and follow it exactly. Read `gh issue view 233 --comments`.
- End each commit message with:
  Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
- Other agents share the moneo-qa backend and QA port 3100:
  - Never `npm run qa:reset`, and never `docker compose -p moneo-qa down`.
  - Never touch the owner's backend (.env, port 3000, project `moneo`).
  - If 3100 is busy, wait and retry. Never kill a process you didn't start.
  - If `npm ci` stalls, retry once with `--prefer-offline`.
- Before finishing: `npm test`, `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run build`.
- Push and open a PR to `main` (`Closes #233`), ending the body with:
  🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
  Never merge.
- Final line: PR <full URL>, head <SHA>, checks and reviews <state>.

indkhan/Moneo
Enforce server-only modules and remove the bank serviceDb re-export
OPEN
Parent tracker: #224

**Priority:** P1 (correctness, security or verification priority).

## Problem and current evidence

lib/supabase-server.ts, lib/service-db.ts, lib/service-keys.ts, lib/bank/server.ts and lib/scalable/server.ts hold server capabilities but lack a consistent client-import barrier. The audit also found serviceDb re-exported through lib/bank/server.ts, encouraging callers and mocks to depend on the wrong module.

## Scope

Apply the supported server-only boundary after checking Next.js guidance and test tooling. Move serviceDb callers and mocks to lib/service-db.ts; remove the re-export. Keep Electron boundaries intact and use existing import-boundary lint where appropriate.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Client code cannot import secret-bearing modules through direct or transitive imports.
- [ ] All serviceDb consumers use the canonical module.
- [ ] Unit tests, typecheck, lint and the source and desktop builds pass.
- [ ] No secrets or server configuration enter client bundles.

## Verification and constraints

Reproduce the current behaviour before changing it. Run the smallest relevant check during implementation, then npm test, npm run lint and npm run typecheck; add a build for app/config changes and real QA browser verification for changed user flows. Use only disposable moneo-qa services, synthetic records and mocked paid integrations. Verify source installation and desktop compatibility. Preserve financial history, corrections and undo. Do not add prose or comments in place of a deterministic boundary.

## Delivery

This issue records follow-up work; it does not claim the change is implemented. Recheck current main and #224 before starting, since the audit counts may have changed. Keep the PR focused and link its checks and relevant evidence here.
